scope: Existing-checkpoint read-only diagnosis on learner only; no actors, TCP, optimization, resumed training or fresh experiment runs
requires: User starts the learner and authorizes connection; current run checkpoint/replay are not local and local Python has no TensorFlow module
checks: Actual actor-loss versus deployed-function gradients and tanh saturation
Both critic action derivatives at actual deterministic policy outputs
Joint same-state scalar action-grid sensitivity and neutral-versus-policy Q gap
Retained factual exploration action support per training condition
Own bootstrap residual, clearly not true Q accuracy
All model/target/BN/optimizer/counter variables unchanged after all queries
interpretation_rules: If critic favors increasing the window while actor remains strongly negative, inspect actor gradient/saturation/BN before a reward patch; Q predictions alone do not establish correct network actions.

If both critics favor shrinking and the retained action data contain almost no nonreducing actions, prioritize identifying reward-scale versus extrapolation/support. Do not claim critic correctness from low TD loss.
If critics disagree or conclusions depend on unsupported action grid points, stop before training and design a bounded factual probe.
Earlier checkpoints query final replay states; all historical on-policy claims are prohibited.
This read-only check cannot open actor updates, choose a new production checkpoint, or schedule long training automatically.
already_confirmed: Source reward/state have a self-peak normalization alias on synthetic fixtures
144 real frozen runs contain observed reward/network-quality conflicts in full and trim10 windows
Gaussian std0.2 supplies extremely sparse nonreducing actions at saturated negative policy output
Current scalar training protocol differs from upstream in several material engineering choices
still_unknown: Exact first update that initiated negative bias in current normal-start runs
Whether current critics or actor optimization primarily sustain the bad window policy
Whether natural-CUBIC slow-start handoff, without auxiliary writes, changes learning outcomes
Whether any reward/exploration correction yields a reliable network/CPU gain
prohibited: Start all five servers for an offline query
Change reward, sampling, initialization and exploration together
